usage.collector_scope: Only proc PCM registration/status, stat/access tests and executable presence; no tinymix/tinycap execution, no PCM/control opens/ioctls, no debugfs reads or writes, no full logs/PIDs/device identifiers. --live not executed this session.

collector.3: PCM metadata unavailable or AWB absent

analyzer.0: incomplete evidence with no detected definite blocker; NEVER readiness approval

usage.limitations: Collector requires trusted stable fixture tree/PATH; checks reject direct symlinks but are not a hostile concurrent-filesystem sandbox. POSIX sh tested on host; Android shell not run. Shell identity access does not establish audioserver DAC/SELinux. Absent tinycap is a diagnostic-tool issue, not a HAL prerequisite. Snapshot carries no authenticated module/build identity.

pcm_contract.capture_device: AWB link; DL1 link is first and AWB second in machine source, often C0D1c. Runtime /proc/asound/pcm must decide; never copy playback C0D0p number.
pcm_contract.latency_limit: Conservative functional profile only, unsuitable as a low-latency hearing-aid design. Do not reduce period below kernel 1024-byte minimum.
pcm_contract.rate_warning: Generic ALSA DAI/hw constraints advertise broader 8k..48k; MIC-specific prepare rejects 11025/12000/22050/24000/44100. Restrict policy/negotiation; do not assume broad hw refine means MIC supports each rate.

route_controls.MIC Input Mux: MIC1 or MIC2 only after board wiring verified; current default MIC1 is not wiring evidence

pcm_contract.no_gain_programming: Existing codec event hardcodes PGA configuration; this task neither verifies nor changes gain/register values.

kernel_prerequisites.evidence: mt6323.c:528-545 + local soc-dapm.c:1518-1522,1737-1745; official v7.0-rc7 independently has same supply exclusion/power rule
kernel_prerequisites.missing: MIC Input -> MIC Route has no signal route to AIF1 Capture. A supply dependency alone cannot carry the input endpoint. Candidate graph repair is AIF1 Capture <- MIC Route while retaining valid supply dependencies; must be reviewed/applied by kernel owner.

AUDCLK supply feeds DAC only, no capture dependency. MIC-only power-up needs verified clock dependency and teardown refcount so stopping playback cannot gate a recording stream. Do not blindly attach downlink NEWIF event: it changes DL controls.
Physical MIC1/MIC2 mapping remains explicitly unknown in source. Requires board evidence; no assumed headset microphone.
Confirm runtime AWB PCM, loaded codec/AFE/machine module identities and audited DAPM graph. Candidate image and working source are not proof of loaded state.

AWB mux is shared with another capture source; source can be changed without active-stream guard (AFE:723-734). Serialize ownership and route changes; reject competing active capture rather than stealing its mux.

minimal_hal_implementation: Do not turn open_input_stream into success until kernel graph/clock and physical mic mapping prerequisites are closed. Allocate a per-input state whose first member is audio_stream_in, with mutex, pcm handle, standby state, verified card/device, format/rate/channel mask, source/device, frame/loss counters and device-owned mute state.

Validate input devices/sources/flags; start with builtin mic and MIC/DEFAULT source, PCM16 mono16k. Reject unimplemented headset, call, hotword, fast and mmap capture routes honestly; do not advertise them. Negotiate explicitly: write a supported config and return -EINVAL for retry rather than silently changing rate under a successful open.

Initialize *stream_in=NULL on failure, clean up partial allocations/PCM/mixer state. Use capture-specific card/device discovery, not existing output constants. Retain ownership of capture route and reject second competing input until multi-stream support exists.

get_input_buffer_size and common.get_buffer_size must agree in bytes; unsupported rate/format/channel masks return zero from get_input_buffer_size. Existing current getter only popcounts channels and ignores rate/format, so it can fabricate support. Populate common get/set sample_rate, format, channel_mask, buffer_size, standby, dump, device, parameters and effect callbacks; return supported errors instead of leaving direct-call callbacks NULL.

Use pcm_open(card, AWB_device, PCM_IN, cfg) only in the implemented input path after prerequisites, validate pcm_is_ready; close on every failure. Mixer changes limited to verified existing route controls, ordered/serialized and restored only by their owner. No raw register/gain writes.

read returns BYTES, not tinyalsa status: AOSP tinyalsa pcm_read returns 0 on successful full operation, while audio_stream_in.read returns the number of delivered bytes. Adapter must avoid returning zero repeatedly to the HIDL reader; reject misaligned requests and prevent overflow. Review actual installed tinyalsa read semantics/partial transfer behavior, not just header signature. On error propagate negative status and do not fabricate successful zero-filled recording; account for XRUN recovery explicitly.

Implement microphone mute as real synchronized state; zero delivered PCM while muted and report mute accurately. Unmute resumes verified path, with no stale audio leakage. Avoid success stubs that discard set_mic_mute.

Provide non-NULL set_gain and get_input_frames_lost: r61 wrapper calls both directly. Gain may explicitly return -ENOSYS without hardware writes. Frames-lost is a reset-on-read frame counter; avoid fabricated exact loss if installed tinyalsa exposes only an overrun count. get_capture_position is optional (wrapper checks NULL); either implement verified frame counter + CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds or return -ENOSYS, never synthetic timestamps.

standby/close must release PCM and capture-owned routes; next read can reopen. Coordinate blocking read vs close and shared clocks; test close during read, repeated standby, errors, mute and concurrent playback. Do not hold a teardown lock forever around an uninterruptible read.

Only then narrow primary input policy to supported PCM16 rates and mono/stereo capabilities actually validated. AudioRecord needs RECORD_AUDIO runtime permission and applicable AppOps; binder/HIDL registration, audioserver device access and SELinux are separate from tinycap/kernel success. Keep HAL module/HIDL ABI versions matched to image.

tinycap_findings.aosp_cli: r61 -n is period_count; -T is duration; default 44100/stereo is not a valid MIC profile. Never run tinycap --help: this version treats argv[1] as a filename before parsing and opens it wb.
tinycap_findings.exit_code_warning: AOSP tinycap main returns 0 after capture_sample returns 0 on pcm_open/malloc failures; process exit0 alone is NOT recording success. A valid later test must check PCM/frame/sample evidence, but no recordings here.
tinycap_findings.existing_diagnostic: scripts/diag/z1_diag_audio.sh:152 specifies -d0 -r44100 -n3. Device0 is not proven capture device, 44100 rejected for MIC, -n3 is not three seconds. Existing script left untouched.
tinycap_findings.broken_staging_source: out/z1_audio_stage/src/tinyalsa/utils/tinycap.c is only 2 bytes; no valid C source evidence. Official r61 copy fetched with provenance.
tinycap_findings.image: Read-only debugfs of out/z1_v44/sys/system_v44.img found regular /bin/tinycap and /bin/tinymix. Image filesystem root differs from mounted /system prefix. Source and policy paths checked separately; no execution/dependency/ABI success inferred.
tinycap_findings.policy: v44 vendor primary XML exposes 11025,12000,22050,24000 unsupported by MIC; 48000 appears twice. Stock XML also contains unsupported44100. Resampler capability must not be presumed in this stub HAL.

future_acceptance_not_executed: Offline callback harness: config negotiation, bytes/frame arithmetic, error cleanup, read returns, mute, mandatory callbacks, concurrent read/close, standby, unsupported flags.
Reviewed kernel build and module/boot identity checks; standalone capture-only and capture+playback clocks/route lifetimes, period IRQ2 and pointer progress.

Only in a separately authorized actual recording run: verify physical mic with consent, non-empty frame count, signal response/no stale buffer, correct duration/rate/channel order, XRUN recovery; protect and dispose of sample data as directed.
Separate Android AudioRecord round trip under runtime recording permission; tinycap pass is not HAL pass. Validate mute/standby, app capture stop and no background mic left enabled.
official_sources: sources/provenance.json contains successful exact URLs/revisions/SHA256 and failed URL attempts. AOSP wrapper canonical paths were discovered from directory listing, not assumed.
boundary: No production source/HAL/DTS/init changes, no board/serial/USB operation, no services/process changes, no recording, no image writes, no git index/commit/push by this task.
